purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: The official city guide describes address/parcel search and drawing the selected parcel polygon with area. The public ArcGIS MapServer traced for the guide contains roads, buildings, neighborhoods and administrative/place layers, not cadastral parcels. The city guide’s parcel tool likely uses another backend, but its schema/anonymous geometry request was not verified. TKGM lists a Denizli Cadastre Directorate and an official public parcel-query service; its UI is identifier-oriented and no query was submitted. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
